text: Identify the exact infotainment family and region-specific firmware likely fitted to a 2021 Australian Hyundai Ioniq 5.
Catalog distinct reverse-engineering paths, evidence, prerequisites, reversibility, risks, and current applicability.
Produce a practical staged plan for the user's car beginning with passive and recoverable evidence acquisition.

Cover the architectural relevance of immobilizer, keyless-entry, gateways, CAN, diagnostics, and safety controllers without operational bypass instructions that enable theft or defeat safety protections.
Use the Parallelism workflow with independent research workers and separate reviewer acceptance.
Create HISTORY.md and CHANGELOG.md and preserve local Git version history for produced project artifacts.

Treat every vehicle subsystem as researchable, including smart key, immobilizer, gateways, telematics, CAN domains, diagnostics, ADAS, and safety controllers; the user does not request car-theft instructions.

Keep the research confidential in the private Ioniq-5 repository; raw research artifacts and owner-authorized identifiers may be retained there, while the downloaded 9.5 GB package tree and live credentials/private keys remain excluded, and do not frame the material as instructions for breaking into a vehicle.
Create and use a private GitHub repository named Ioniq-5 for reviewed project artifacts.

Use extensive non-duplicative Parallelism and a Grok, Astra and Fable Council for acceptance, preserving findings and using an explicit DeepSeek replacement generation if a requested route becomes unavailable.
Install and run Hyundai Navigation Updater, download the official Australian 2021-23 Ioniq 5 package for read-only local inspection, and stop before USB or vehicle use.
Correct the active vehicle scope to a UK-origin 2021 Ioniq 5 and obtain the vehicle-family-correct official European Standard Gen5W package.
Statically extract and decompile the exact European firmware to determine its operating system, kernel, CPU/platform, hardening and trust model.
Assess published root and native application-loading methods against the exact build, including prerequisites and unknowns, without developing a novel zero-day or live vehicle-compromise chain.
Compare the exact European and Australian packages and produce a safe region-transition feasibility assessment.
Preserve concurrent Kona-owned files and history while integrating Ioniq research.
